memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Asthma with vitamin B12 deficiency.
Symptoms: intermittent wheeze, exertional dyspnoea, occasional nocturnal cough; mild fatigue. Examination: mild expiratory wheeze bilaterally, normal cardiac auscultation, no cyanosis. Smoking: never, pack-years 0. Spirometry: FEV1 2.30 L (78% predicted), FVC 2.80 L (85% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.82. Change in FEV1 since prior: N/A. Asthma Control Test score 16 (not well controlled). Technique checked: correct for salbutamol MDI and budesonide-formoterol dry powder device; inspiratory flow adequate.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 100 mcg, 2 puffs SOS.
Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg dry powder inhaler, 1 puff BD.
Montelukast sodium 10 mg tablet, HS.
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg tablet, OD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum vitamin B12: 150 pg/mL (ref 200-900).
Haemoglobin: 11.2 g/dL (ref 12.0-15.5).
MCV: 98 fL (ref 80-100).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I work as a postal worker, walking routes daily. I notice wheeze after climbing stairs and feel tired. My diet is vegetarian; I take no supplements.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Asthma, vitamin B12 deficiency on treatment.
Symptoms: reduced wheeze, occasional cough, improved energy. Examination: mild end-expiratory wheeze, otherwise clear. Smoking: never. Spirometry: FEV1 2.55 L (87% predicted) ↑0.25 L, FVC 2.95 L (90% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.86. Asthma Control Test score 20 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct; dry powder device flow adequate.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 100 mcg, 2 puffs SOS.
Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg dry powder inhaler, 2 puffs BD (increased).
Montelukast sodium 10 mg tablet, HS.
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg tablet, OD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum vitamin B12: 340 pg/mL (ref 200-900).
Haemoglobin: 12.6 g/dL (ref 12.0-15.5).
MCV: 92 fL (ref 80-100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Asthma, vitamin B12 deficiency stable.
Symptoms: occasional nocturnal cough, no daytime wheeze. Examination: clear lungs. Smoking: never. Spirometry: FEV1 2.48 L (85% predicted) ↓0.07 L, FVC 2.90 L (89% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.86. Asthma Control Test score 18 (not well controlled). Technique corrected: patient was holding breath too short; taught 5‑second hold after actuation.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 100 mcg, 2 puffs SOS.
Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg dry powder inhaler, 2 puffs BD (maintained).
Montelukast sodium 10 mg tablet, HS (continued).
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg tablet, OD.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Chest X-ray (PA): lungs clear, no infiltrate, cardiac size normal. No evidence of consolidation or hyperinflation.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Asthma, vitamin B12 deficiency.
Symptoms: increased daytime wheeze, night cough 2‑3x/week. Examination: bilateral end‑expiratory wheeze. Smoking: never. Spirometry: FEV1 2.30 L (79% predicted) ↓0.18 L, FVC 2.78 L (85% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.83. Asthma Control Test score 15 (not well controlled). Technique checked: correct after reinforcement.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Salbutamol metered-dose inhaler 100 mcg, 2 puffs SOS.
Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg dry powder inhaler, 2 puffs BD (maintained).
Montelukast sodium 10 mg tablet, HS stopped.
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg tablet, OD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum vitamin B12: 420 pg/mL (ref 200-900).
Haemoglobin: 13.4 g/dL (ref 12.0-15.5).
MCV: 89 fL (ref 80-100).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referred to ENT for evaluation of allergic rhinitis contributing to asthma symptoms. Requested skin prick testing and nasal steroid recommendation.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: ENT reply: mild intermittent allergic rhinitis, negative skin prick to common aeroallergens. Recommended intranasal corticosteroid spray as needed. No further action required.

memories.text:
Asthma, vitamin B12 deficiency.
Symptoms: well‑controlled, rare wheeze, no nocturnal cough. Examination: clear lungs. Smoking: never. Spirometry: FEV1 2.58 L (88% predicted) ↑0.28 L, FVC 3.02 L (92% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.86. Asthma Control Test score 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct; dry powder device flow adequate.
